description: Connect YOUR OWN account with its signed-in session string, so the write tools and page_followers act as you. The session is checked live once, stored encrypted, never returned and deleted on account_disconnect; it replaces any account connected before. Free. A session string is a credential: pass it only when the user gives it. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

account_id.description: Which connected account (accounts_list). Optional while this key has exactly one.

proxy_url.description: Optional: your own http, https or socks5 proxy for this account.

user_agent.description: Optional: the browser user agent the session was created with.

name: account_connect
title: Connect Your Account
